David. Okay, who wants to get underway?  Davide? I think we started quite well,  
creating chances. Then when they scored the first  goal, the game completely changed the dynamic of  
the game. I think for 20-25 minutes until the  first half, we were not good enough, especially  
defensively, because the two goals we concede  both from our mistake and then the second-half,  
we just came back in the game. Enzo, there  was a lot of heads in hand for the Putting  
your head in your hands with the chances that  were going by at the end. Just how big does  
it feel not having those two points given the  champions? Yeah, no, as I said at the beginning,  
it's tough. It's tough because even the first 20  minutes, you know, at this stage of the season  
against these kind of teams, if you are able to  score the first one, the game completely changed  
in your side. Unfortunately, we miss chances  and then we concede. And I think the team  
was not good enough for indifferent things. And  this is where we need to give one step forward and  
react in the right way. In terms of the way  they were playing or a mentality thing? No,  
no. In terms of, I think we lost a little bit  confidence because we concede probably because,  
you know, the environment. And this is the moment  that you have to continue doing the right things  
and don't change plan. Also because we are a team  that most of the times, our goal kick, we start  
from playing short. The second goal, we decide to  play long because the environment is there. And we  
can see the second one. So you have to be strong.  You have to continue with the things that you are  
doing. Peter? Enzo, I just wanted to ask you about  that, specifically with the second goal. Because  
it felt like after the first goal wins in, the  crowd, the atmosphere, everything changed. Is it  
an issue with the players and how they responded  to that? Do you want more from the supporters  
in that moment? And you mentioned also the goal  kick. I presume that's not something you wanted  
to see. No, it's just for sure not. But I can  understand, because probably we consider the goal,  
and they decide to play long ball. But sometimes--  I said many times-- sometimes you go long, doesn't  
mean that you are going to control something.  And the second goal we can see is for that.  
And then in terms of fans, I said many times, we  are stronger with our fans, we are a better team,  
and it's up to them to decide the way. For sure  today, probably, you know, with the 0-1, 0-2,  
it's normal to be in the way they were. Simon.  Enzo, Chelsea having a pretty tough run in. How  
costly could this result be? And the fact that  only one point from two games against Ipswich,  
could these results, are you worried that  you could come back to these two games being  
different between Champions League? Yeah, at the  end of the season, we see, hopefully not for us.  
But I think we are going from now on us But  the same, the other six, seven clubs that  
we are involved in Champion League spot, I think  we are going to win games, but at the same time,  
we are going to drop points because it's normal.  For sure, probably today, you don't expect to drop  
points, especially in the way you start the game,  because in the way we start again, I think for all  
of us, it's just a matter of when they're going to  score. But then we concede the goal and completely  
change all the dynamic of the game. Tom. Enzo,  you mentioned how dominant you've been in the  
first 20 minutes before the Ipswich opening goal.  But what happened in that period between that goal  
and half-time? Because it wasn't just the second  goal. You felt like for all of that period,  
you lost some control, your players maybe  lost some direction. What happened there,  
and how did you manage to restore it a little  bit at half-time? No, yeah. I think both goals  
we concede, both we can defend better. But if you  analyse both goals, the first goal is from Enzo,  
long ball, lose the ball, we concede. Second one  is goal kick, long ball, we concede. Probably we  
lost a little bit confidence, you know, because we  were in control, we were playing well. The goal we  
concede, probably the players, they lost a little  bit, you know, confidence inside the pitch because  
it's a game that you must win game, you have  to win. So when you see yourself one is down,  
probably, but this is in that moment, My message  of time was just that, guys, now is the moment  
that we need to react. We cannot continue  the way we were in the last 20, 25 minutes of  
first half. And how would you reflect on how the  second-half went for Chelsea? I think second-half,  
we were our team. We were in the way, creating  many chances, playing the opposite side. We were  
much more dynamic. We were much more, I think,  better second-half. We do two more, Jacob and  
John. Why do you think that the environment that  you say has become an issue here? I didn't say  
that the environment is an issue for us, because  I always said that with our fans, with us,  
we are a better team. They have been there all  season, all my way. For sure today, in the moment  
that we are in a difficult moment, you can expect  them that they are not happy, but in the same  
moment, probably is the moment that we need. We  need the players, especially the players that are  
inside the pitch, is the moment that they probably  need more support. John. Jadon Sancho obviously  
scored a high-quality equaliser. How would you sum  up his loan spell so far and what are the chances  
of him staying on next season? Yeah, no, he's  doing well. Today we decided to start with Pedro,  
Noni. Noni is back from injuries, scored  twice the other day. Pedro is doing well,  
and Jadon is playing almost every game. The  idea was just to refresh a little bit with him,  
knowing that he's going to give us a good moment,  goal, assist, and he's showing so and then for  
the future to be honest, now is the moment.  With one month to go, it's just the focus.  
It's about how we can finish, and then we have  time to decide. Thanks, everyone. Thank you.
title: Enzo Maresca pre-match press conference | Chelsea 2-2 Ipswich Town
